senses.sense_definition: Iemand die professioneel of als vrijwilliger is opgeleid om branden te blussen en hulp te verlenen bij ongevallen.

examples.text: Het was altijd mijn droom om <w>brandweerman</w> te worden.

target_lang_translations.en: It was always my dream to become a <w>firefighter</w>.

examples.text: De <w>brandweermannen</w> kwamen snel aan bij het brandende huis.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>firefighters</w> arrived quickly at the burning house.

target_lang_definitions.en: A person trained, either professionally or as a volunteer, to extinguish fires and provide assistance during accidents.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: The standard, gender-neutral term for someone trained to put out fires.
A traditional term for a person who fights fires; note that it is gender-specific and sometimes refers to historical roles on steam engines.
